title: Behaviour runs that could not act are errors, and the documented runner can act
goal: A runner without tool permissions never counts as a rule failure
acceptance: Failing-first fixture tests: a run that changed nothing in a scenario where a correct run must act, or whose transcript asks for permissions without acting, is an error (runner lacks permissions?), counted apart from passes and failures; a correct no-change run still passes
rule-review.md documents a runner with edit, git, npm and node permissions; patch release after a confirmed merge
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented; no personal data.
escalation: Running real agents is the owner's runner, never CI

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed: one result kind in one copied tool, a documented command, fixture tests and a patch release. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 for 10.15.1 (failing-first test committed before the fix); review, CI and tag remain. Released in v10.15.1 (#274; main CI green on 351f3e2 confirmed before tagging). Closed 2026-11-25.
